fieldValues.title: The compass is shown, not named
fieldValues.article_text: The decision says what the compass settles and what it leaves open, in words. A question the compass settles is recorded as a ruling with its case, and only what it leaves open is asked. A pole label on an option must survive checking: an option that reverses a standing position is not labelled as continuity with it. Checked by: mechanical for presence; judgement for honesty.
fieldValues.rationale: Added from srs#998, not from the meeting. Applies 7ee8fa01 (a decision is shown with its compass) and remedy dfa1059e.
